To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a product centric knowledge-based system for sustainable manufacturing that can be used to identify and propose alternatives to improve the sustainability of manufacturing processes.
the paper describes a product-centric ontology, which is able to support the identification and the evaluation of sustainable change opportunities in manufacturing processes.
we developed an ontology-based knowledge system for sustainable manufacturing, which can automatically identify change opportunities, and propose alternative scenarios.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an ontology-based system able to support sustainable manufacturing in the product lifecycle.

the definition of an ontological model of the product and of the production system, and with the design of an expert system that can automatically identify the change opportunities and propose alternatives on the product and production system.

the design and development of a knowledge based system that is able to support sustainable manufacturing in a flexible and efficient way, by means of an ontology-based approach, in which concepts are associated to functions, and sustainable manufacturing knowledge is used to support the design of sustainable production scenarios.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the paper proposes an ontology-based system for supporting sustainable manufacturing.

the proposed approach is able to provide an effective support to manufacturing sustainability by enabling the identification of the most suitable manufacturing process to be used for the production of each component of the final product.
this paper presents a new approach for the design of a sustainable manufacturing system, in which a product-centric ontology is used for supporting the decision-making process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed ontology-based system is a first step towards the development of a sustainable manufacturing expert system.
, starting from a product model, we can automatically identify change opportunities to improve the product sustainability.

the paper proposes a knowledge-based system able to automatically support the decision-making process of the manufacturing manager, by suggesting the best solution in terms of sustainable manufacturing.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed ontology-based knowledge system, which is the first step towards a sustainable manufacturing expert system, can be applied to different manufacturing scenarios and can support the decision maker in identifying change opportunities.
, in order to be able to provide the right support, the system needs a deep understanding of the manufacturing domain.
a sustainable manufacturing expert system is feasible, but the knowledge required to build it is still missing.
